entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Mr. Tuushar Sonawane, learned Advocate for the Applicant.
Mr. Tanveer G. Khan, learned A.P.P. for the State/Respondent.

_ _  CORAM : ASHWIN D. BHOBE, J.
DATE : 12th FEBRUARY 2026.
Heard Mr. Tuushar Sonawane, learned Advocate for the Applicant and Mr. Tanveer Khan, learned A.P.P. for the State/Respondent.

2. By the present Criminal Application, the Applicant is seeking to quash First Information Report bearing Crime No. 354 of 2025 dated 05.11.2025 for the offences punishable under Sections 275, 274, 223 & 123 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 along with Sections 59, 30(2)(a), 27(2)(e), 26(2)(iv), 26(2)(ii) & 26(2)(i) of the Food Safety & Standards Act, 2006 registered with Bhayander Police Station,
District-Mira-Bhayander, Vasai-Virar Police Commissionarate.

entities.text:
Bhayander Police Station,
District-Mira-Bhayander, Vasai-Virar Police Commissionarate
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 3. Mr. Tuushar Sonawane, learned Advocate for the Applicant submits that the issue involved in the present Criminal Application is pending for consideration before the Hon'ble Supreme Court.
He further submits that similar issues are involved in Criminal Writ Petition Nos. 280 of 2025, 3444 of 2025 and 4078 of 2025.

entities.text: Criminal Writ Petition Nos. 280 of 2025, 3444 of 2025 and 4078 of 2025
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: He Gitalaxmi 909-APL-294-2026.doc refers to the orders passed in the above said Petitions, wherein this Court has admitted the same and granted interim reliefs.

4. Mr. Tanveer Khan, learned A.P.P. for the State/Respondent does not dispute that the issue involved in the present Criminal Application is subject matter of the Petitions, referred by the Applicant in the present Criminal Application.

He submits that the present Criminal Application filed under Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (for short "BNSS") be tagged along with the Vikas Umakant Chaudhari vs State Of Maharashtra on 12 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/115027208/
1 aforesaid Petitions.
5.

entities.text: Vikas Umakant Chaudhari vs State Of Maharashtra
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Mr. Tuushar Sonawane, learned Advocate for the Applicant submits that the interim orders granted in the aforesaid Petitions, be also granted in this Criminal Application.
6. Mr. Tanveer Khan, learned A.P.P. for the State/Respondent does not object to the said request.

7. In view of the above, further proceedings arising out of Crime No. 354 of 2025 dated 05.11.2025 registered with Bhayander Police Station, District-Mira-Bhayander,
Vasai-Virar Police Commissionarate, are stayed qua the Applicant.

8. Tag the present Criminal Application along with Criminal Writ Petition Nos. 280 of 2025, 3444 of 2025 and 4078 of 2025.
[ASHWIN D. BHOBE, J.] GITALAXMI KRISHNA KRISHNA KOTAWADEKAR KOTAWADEKAR Date:
